controls.description: Two-way split on a prior step's output. FLAT fields on the step itself: no condition/if/when wrapper object. Omit op and value for the strict-boolean form (on must resolve to a boolean); supply op AND value together to compare. then and else are LISTS OF STEP IDS (never inline step objects); an empty arm falls through to the next step. NOTE: to try N stations until one connects, pass them all to one radio.connect - do not build per-station branching.

fields.else: LIST of step ids to run otherwise (may be [])
fields.on: bare output path, e.g. "s1.connected" or "s1.indices.k_index" (no $ prefix)
fields.op: optional eq | ne | lt | lte | gt | gte - supplied together with value
fields.then: LIST of step ids to run when the condition holds
fields.value: comparison right-hand side, required with op

controls.description: Pause the track: a relative duration or an alignment boundary.
Re-run a failing action step with backoff.

fields.step: id of the action step to wrap (same track)

controls.description: Invoke another saved routine by name.

fields.args: optional args object bound to its inputs
fields.routine: name of the routine to invoke
fields.sync: optional; true (default) awaits the child, false is fire-and-forget

controls.description: Terminate the track. failed: true marks the run failed.

fields.reason: optional string shown in the journal

trigger_kinds.description: Fires only when the operator (or an agent run request) starts the routine explicitly. No parameters.
Fires on an interval. "top of every hour" = every "1h" with align "hour".

fields.align: optional "hour" | "day" — align fires to the top of the hour/day
